system.description:
Bestial Art: Hunter · cast at A-Rank · no type

Your Strength becomes 22 or your Dexterity becomes 18 (your choice).

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 2d8 slashing, using the changed ability for your unarmed attacks.

+20 speed.

Opportunity attacks you make are at advantage.

When you take the Attack action, you make two attacks instead of one; if you already can, one additional unarmed attack.

You can't be seen by Chakra Sight or sensed by effects that sense chakra.
